content: Member Profile Badges Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000055542 Add credibility and more awareness to member profiles by assigning unique digital badges to specific membership levels. Upload the own badge images and assign them to the membership levels. Once uploaded, all the member profiles in that membership level will display their special digital badge. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Member Profile Badges Add-On Enabling the Add-On 1. Go to Finance > Membership Plans : 2. Find the membership plan and click on Edit: 3. Click on the Profile Page tab: 4. Scroll down until the admin sees these options: Recommended sizes Profile Page Badge: 50px x 50px Search Results Badge: 50px x 50px Member Dashboard Badge: 250px x 250px Once uploaded, all members in that membership plan will have the profile badge. Profile Page Badge: Search Results Badge: Member Dashboard Badge: To learn more about this and how it would show on the website, please read this article below: Finance » Membership Plans » Member's Dashboard tab: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
